questions.q: How long is the supervised test for Component 2 (Externally Set Assignment)?
questions.why: The final outcome is produced during a supervised test of 8 hours' total duration.
Component 2 is 100 marks and 50% of the qualification.

questions.q: Which statement is true about supporting studies?
options: They are made after the test
They must be available to you during the test
questions.why: Supporting studies are made in the preparation period and must be available during the supervised test.

questions.q: Explain the difference between supporting studies and the final outcome in Component 2.
questions.model: Supporting studies are made in the preparation period and show recording, research, experiments and development. The final outcome is made in the 8-hour supervised test. Both are marked together.
